milestones.title: GPT-Signal: Generative AI for Semi-automated Feature Engineering in the Alpha Research Process
milestones.evaluated_scope: Published EVC signal and source-signed direction; JKP ratio conventions, U.S. universe, monthly cadence, common value-weighted decile portfolio, costs and factor attribution are disclosed adaptations.
milestones.next_action: Closed. Do not alter the sign, formula or benchmark after the observed result; reopen only for concrete new source evidence.
milestones.closure_reason: One source-selected headline signal produced a complete 305-month common-benchmark path and verdict; the adaptation and non-claims are explicit.

milestones.title: CryptoTrade: A Reflective LLM-based Agent to Guide Zero-shot Cryptocurrency Trading
milestones.evaluated_scope: No common-benchmark return: the central stateful four-call reflective agent has no defensible monthly U.S./JKP input, cross-sectional, or portfolio transfer without replacing most of its method.
milestones.next_action: Closed. Preserve the deterministic crypto-baseline and author-output audits separately; do not relabel them as the headline agent.
milestones.closure_reason: A direct common-universe port requires 1,220,000 stateful LLM calls plus invented stock analogues for crypto transaction/news state and a new portfolio aggregation rule; every bounded shortcut tested at the design boundary removes the central reflective-agent mechanism.

milestones.title: Can Large Language Models Mine Interpretable Financial Factors More Effectively? A Neural-Symbolic Factor Mining Agent Model
milestones.evaluated_scope: No common-task return: the headline is a factor-mining agent, but neither an executable miner nor a final mined factor/strategy is released, and the printed algorithm is internally inconsistent.
milestones.next_action: Closed. Keep the prompt and paper formula/configuration findings as specification evidence; do not promote the old momentum/value motif mapping to FAMA.
milestones.closure_reason: The only recovered prompt lacks its required function definition; the initial factor universe is 38 versus 71, the clustering equation changes the method, Algorithm 1 conflicts with the narrative, and no final factor or portfolio rule exists to evaluate without designing a new miner.
